answer: Demand a cloud receipt. Each agent submits the signed instance-identity document its host provider issues, naming a billing account that passed a card and tax check, and one billing account backs only one seat. To forge 300 clones, an attacker must open 300 verified billing accounts at about 25 tokens each, 7,500 tokens up front, and cheap shell accounts still bunch into the same data-center region, standing out like umber tracks across white tundra snow.
